files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Overview: the list "Next follow-ups" shows the waiting tasks whose follow-up date comes in the next 14 days
- Timeline: waiting tasks are striped and a bell marks the follow-up date (red once it is reached); tasks that only have a follow-up date are shown as well

### Changed
- The follow-up date is now a reminder in the task (8 o'clock on that day) instead of its start date. Start and due date stay the plan, also on the timeline, and other apps, for example on the phone, remind you on that day. In the sidebar it is listed under "Reminders" as "Follow-up: …" and can be moved or removed there
- Tasks that waited before keep their follow-up date: without the reminder the start date counts as before. When a new follow-up date is set for such a task, the date moves into the reminder and the start date is removed (the dialog says so)
- New tasks in the collections "Waiting" and "Follow-up due" get the reminder instead of a start date
- The table has separate columns "Start" and "Follow-up"; a click on the follow-up date opens the dialog. New columns appear next to the column they follow by default
- "Current" leaves out a waiting task until its follow-up date and shows it again on that day, even if its planned start is later
- Ending waiting keeps a planned start; with "Tasks that start in the future are waiting" switched on, a start in the future moves to today instead of being removed

### Fixed
- With "Tasks that start in the future are waiting" switched off, moving a task with a planned start in the future on the board removed its start date
